risks.risk: Battery is dead or has significantly degraded capacity.
risks.proof: A continuous video clip showing the fan running on battery power for a significant duration or a voltage test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard non-rechargeable standing fan with a faulty battery.

risks.risk: Motor is burnt, weak, or excessively noisy.
risks.proof: A video clip with sound showing the fan running at all speed settings.
A video clip showing the fan head rotating side-to-side.

risks.risk: Missing remote control (standard for many Qasa rechargeable models).
risks.proof: A photo of the remote control next to the fan.

proof_requests: Video of the fan running on battery power (unplugged).
Video showing the fan oscillating and switching through all speed modes.
Photo of the model sticker on the back or motor housing.
Photo of the receipt and warranty card mentioned by the seller.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a QASA standing fan. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional battery and corded operation only) until further proof is provided.
